title: Fire Extinguisher Inspection
short_description: NFPA 10 checklists, QR tag scanning and signed PDF reports for extinguishers

guides.title: Fire Extinguisher Due Date Calculator (NFPA 10)
guides.description: Enter an extinguisher's type and last service dates to get its next monthly, annual, 6-year and hydrostatic test dates, with the formulas explained.

guides.title: Fire Extinguisher Hydrostatic Test Interval Chart
guides.description: Chart of NFPA 10 monthly, annual, 6-year maintenance and hydrostatic test intervals for ABC, CO2, water, foam, wet chemical and other extinguishers.

guides.title: NFPA 10 Monthly and Annual Inspection Checklist
guides.description: The 8 monthly and 16 annual fire extinguisher checks under NFPA 10, which items change by extinguisher type, and what to record when one fails.
